title: The Unheard
description: After undergoing an experimental procedure to restore her damaged hearing, 20-year-old Chloe Grayden begins to suffer from auditory hallucinations seemingly related to the mysterious disappearance of her mother.

title: The Dead Room
description: Two scientists (Jed Brophy, Jeffrey Thomas) and a young psychic (Laura Petersen) encounter a demonic spirit at a haunted New Zealand farmhouse.

title: Ghost Stories
description: A professor investigates three chilling and inexplicable cases related to an abandoned asylum, a car accident and the spirit of an unborn child. Even scarier -- each of the macabre tales seems to have a sinister connection to his own life.

title: Night's End
description: After moving into a haunted apartment, a shut-in hires a stranger to perform an exorcism.

title: Haunter
description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

title: May The Devil Take You Too
description: Two years after escaping from a demonic terror, Alfie and Nara try to continue their lives, but Alfie is still haunted by feelings of guilt and unnatural visions.

title: Pay the Ghost
description: Haunted by eerie images and unexplainable messages, a man (Nicolas Cage) tries to unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of his son.

title: The Houses October Built
description: Friends (Brandy Schaefer, Mikey Roe, Jeff Larson) encounter genuine horror during a road trip to visit haunted houses.

title: I Remember You
description: A young man and woman move to a small, abandoned town in Iceland and begin renovations on an old house. Little by little they learn about the town's dark history.

title: A Wounded Fawn
description: A serial killer brings an unsuspecting new victim on a weekend getaway to add another body to his ever-growing count. She's buying into his faux charms, and he's eagerly lusting for blood.

title: Perpetrator
description: Jonny Baptiste is sent to live with her estranged Aunt Hildie. On her 18th birthday, she experiences a family spell that redefines her, called Forevering. When several girls go missing at school, a feral Jonny hunts the perpetrator.

title: The Poltergeist of Borley Forest
description: A teenager visits a haunted forest and thinks a violent poltergeist has followed her home.

title: Birth/Rebirth
description: A morgue technician reanimates the body of a little girl, but must harvest biological materials from pregnant women to keep her breathing. When the girl's mother, a nurse, discovers her baby is alive, the two make a dark deal.
